name: Matte-Finish Aluminum Soda Can
description: A slim, standard-format aluminum beverage can with a smooth matte powder-coat finish in pale yellow, accented by a narrow matte citrus-green stripe wrapping the mid-body, sealed with a standard brushed-aluminum pull-tab lid.
materials: Matte-finish powder-coated aluminum can body; bare brushed aluminum lid, rivet, and pull-tab.
primaryColors: Matte pale yellow body with a matte citrus-green horizontal stripe; bare silver aluminum lid.
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, printing, or embossed lettering anywhere on the can; never add a label or emblem; no props, hands, or presenter in frame; background stays a clean white or very light neutral studio backdrop with soft even lighting only.
preservationNotes: Keep the can's slim cylindrical proportions, matte pale-yellow body color, and the citrus-green stripe's width and vertical position identical and consistent across all four angles; lid geometry (rim, dome, rivet, pull-tab) must match exactly between the front/three-quarter views and the cap-closure macro.
